name: Vendor Name
instructions: The supplier's full legal name exactly as shown. Where to look: Vendor, Supplier, From, Remit To, letterhead, or Supplier of Record section.

name: Vendor Tax ID
instructions: The vendor's US tax identifier (EIN) formatted NN-NNNNNNN. Preserve all characters and leading zeros. Where to look: Tax ID, Tax Ref, EIN, VAT, Supplier Tax ID / VAT, or supplier registration section.

name: Invoice Number
instructions: The vendor's invoice or document number, including any prefix and punctuation. Where to look: Invoice No., Invoice #, Document Number, or the invoice header.

name: Invoice Date
instructions: The date the invoice was issued. Where to look: Invoice Date, Date, Issued, or the invoice header. Do not use the order date, ship date, or service date.

name: PO Number
instructions: The purchase-order reference the invoice bills against, including its prefix. Preserve all digits and leading zeros. Where to look: Customer PO, PO, PO Reference, Purchase Order, or the procurement section.

name: Total Amount
instructions: The grand total payable, including tax. Extract the final total, not the subtotal or amount before tax. Where to look: Total Due, Total, Gross Payable, Amount Due, or the totals block.

name: Currency
instructions: The three-letter currency code (USD on every packet), or the currency implied by the invoice's currency symbol. Where to look: Currency, Billing Currency, the currency symbol on the total, or the totals block.

name: Due Date
instructions: The date payment is due. Where to look: Payment Due By, Net Due Date, Due Date, or derived from the invoice date plus the payment terms.
